intro: As the Nightbane pack encroaches further upon Darkshire, Calor tasks adventurers with striking down the pack's primary rank-and-file stalkers. These ferocious Dark Runners have overrun the nearby Rotting Orchard, threatening to completely surround the besieged town.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You might have noticed some larger worgen wandering around with the Shadow Weavers in the woods? From what we can tell, these Dark Runners make up the bulk of the worgen numbers.
On my rangings, I've also noticed that they have overrun the Rotting Orchard southwest of town. These worgen are a bit tougher than the last you faced.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Back so soon, friend? I hope you haven't come to tell me you've given up.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You performed well against the Dark Runners, friend. But it seems as though their numbers are inexhaustible. Every time we make progress, more spring up to refill their ranks.
What is the evil power that draws them here? Why have they come to disturb our unhappy realm...
I will put my faith in Master Carevin. No doubt he will get to the bottom of the problem.
